channel.title: Violations Watch: Saudi Arabia
channel.description: New incidents reported in Saudi Arabia. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Houthi drone attack hits the Public Investment Fund tower in Riyadh again on 24 Nov, injuring 11 people, nine of them foreign nationals, Saudi authorities say
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Houthis (Ansar Allah). Reported casualties: 11 injured. Disputed or caveats: Figures from the Saudi-led coalition; Houthis claimed the attack. 4 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2014

item.title: Houthi missile strike damages Riyadh's tallest building
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Houthi forces (Ansar Allah). Disputed or caveats: Casualties not reported. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1415

item.title: Houthi missile and drone attack on Riyadh on 19 Nov damages the Public Investment Fund tower in the King Abdullah Financial District; no injuries reported, the coalition says interceptor debris caused the damage (AP, AFP, Reuters via channels)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Houthi forces (Ansar Allah). Disputed or caveats: Houthis say they targeted the "financial centre" and airports; the coalition attributes the damage to interception debris. 9 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1373

item.title: Saudi Arabia executes two Shia men from the Eastern Province on terrorism charges; pro-Axis channels name them as Jawad Qurairis and Fadel al-Safwani
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Types: Executions, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Saudi authorities. Reported casualties: 2 killed. Disputed or caveats: Saudi interior ministry says they were convicted of terrorism; names and claims of unfair charges come only from party-affiliated (pro-Axis/Iranian state) channels. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0615
